name: bs_score
label: Bullshit Score
description: Deterministic Bullshit Score. One score, per-review-type weights. Starts at 0; higher means more bullshit.

depth.description: Review types whose audit is incomplete without reading code. When a payload carries an `audit.files_read` block, bs-score checks it; when it does not, the report says so instead of assuming.

types.breaking_bug: Crash, wrong result, data loss, or a documented workflow that cannot run
types.security_issue: Auth, injection, secrets, privilege, or unsafe-instruction issue
types.missing_feature: Capability asserted by docs/skill/agent/prompt with no implementation
types.bug: Incorrect behaviour that is not catastrophic
types.wrong_claim: A stated claim contradicted by the artifact it describes

repo.description: Whole-repository honesty audit: docs claims plus a deep code pass.

pr.description: Pre-merge gate. Defects about to land outweigh documentation drift.

branch.description: Same as pr; the diff is the unit of review.

review.description: Grading a PR review. A reviewer's currency is claims, so false claims and hollow verification dominate; a real defect the review missed costs more than a mislabelled one.

type_notes.missing_feature: Verification claimed but never performed (hollow 'verified: no secrets')
type_notes.bug: A real defect present in the diff that the review did not report
type_notes.wrong_claim: A review assertion contradicted by the diff or code

skill.description: Skill pack hygiene: SKILL.md against the scripts and helpers it names. Advertising a capability with no implementation is the defining skill failure.

agent.description: Agent/persona config hygiene. A config that instructs unsafe behaviour is the highest-stakes failure; phantom tools and internal contradictions follow.

prompt.description: One or more prompts (system/developer/tool/persona). Injection surface and secret handling dominate; contradictions and unsupported guarantees are the common defects.

type_notes.breaking_bug: An instruction that makes the prompt's own stated workflow impossible to follow
type_notes.security_issue: Treats untrusted content as instructions, leaks secrets, or disables a safety gate
type_notes.missing_feature: Promises an output, format, or tool the prompt never specifies how to produce
type_notes.bug: Instruction that reliably produces wrong behaviour (ambiguous precedence, wrong default)
type_notes.wrong_claim: Self-contradiction, or a guarantee the prompt cannot enforce
